raw_text:
Please also reference `@.agents/memories/20-tooling.md` as needed.
Follow RuleSync: `.rulesync/` is the source of truth. Author changes in `rules`, `skills`, `subagents`, `commands`, `hooks`, and `mcp` there first; generated targets/prompts are build artifacts—regenerate, never hand-edit.
Validate with the system-wide binary: `rulesync generate --check`; intentionally regenerate with `rulesync generate`. Review source and generated diffs together. **Verify target configurations** using `.rulesync/verification/` checklists before committing.
Keep frontmatter RuleSync-compliant; keep commands deterministic. Route hook-only targets through generated rules/hook text, not unavailable skills/commands. Support is asymmetric: author shared behavior once, target blocks only where runtime differs.
